intro.h2: Cabinets and counters from people who install them
paragraphs: HCS Kitchen and Bath sells kitchen cabinets in Memphis and installs them too. Cabinets, countertops and hardware come from one company, so the same people who help you choose them are the ones responsible for making them fit. You deal with one team from the order to the install, for a single room or a full remodel.

Clients notice the fit. One reviewer said the granite countertops arrived on time and fit correctly. Another used HCS for both kitchen and bath cabinets during a full remodel. A recent client needed a kitchen and bathroom adapted to his special needs, and wrote that the team simply helped him, with no one treating him any differently.

items.name: Kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: HCS sells and installs kitchen cabinets, from shaker islands with deep drawer stacks to tall pantry and wall cabinets. One finished kitchen has two islands, a wood range hood and gray upper cabinets around a built-in refrigerator.

about.text: HCS Kitchen and Bath is a cabinet and countertop company with a location at 7560 A E Beaty Dr in Memphis, open weekdays from 9 to 5. The company sells and installs cabinets, countertops and hardware, and it handles both insurance claim repairs and planned remodels. Its Facebook page lists the business in Bartlett. Reviewers describe the people as ethical, easy to work with and genuinely helpful. To talk about your kitchen or bath, call the office or email Shane directly at shane@hcskitchenandbath.com.

image.alt: Dark stained kitchen island with a gold and cream granite countertop and cream perimeter cabinets

process.h2: How a cabinet or remodel job works

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (901) 384-8755 or email shane@hcskitchenandbath.com with your project, whether it is a remodel, a cabinet order or an insurance claim.

steps.title: Choose cabinets and tops
steps.text: Pick cabinet style, finish and hardware, plus the countertop material, with help from the HCS team on what fits your space.

steps.title: Measure and order
steps.text: HCS measures the room so cabinets and countertops are ordered to fit, then confirms the price and install date with you.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: The crew installs cabinets first, then countertops and hardware, and handles the wider remodel work if your job includes it.

steps.title: Final check
steps.text: Walk through the finished kitchen or bath with the team and open the doors and drawers before the job wraps up.

service_area.h2: Kitchen cabinets in Memphis and Bartlett
service_area.text: HCS Kitchen and Bath is located at 7560 A E Beaty Dr in Memphis, Tennessee, and its Facebook page lists the business in Bartlett. The office is open on weekdays, so call ahead before you stop by. If you live elsewhere in the Memphis area, call (901) 384-8755 to check whether your project is in range before you plan around it.

items.q: Do you sell cabinets, install them, or both?
items.a: Both. HCS Kitchen and Bath sells and installs cabinets, countertops and hardware. That means one team is responsible for the order and the install, and for making sure the countertops fit the cabinets they sit on. HCS also takes on full kitchen and bath remodels.

items.q: Can you help with an insurance claim?
items.a: Yes. HCS works on insurance claim jobs as well as planned remodels. If your kitchen or bathroom is part of an insurance claim, call (901) 384-8755 and explain what the claim covers so the team can talk through replacing the cabinets, countertops and hardware with you.

items.q: Can you remodel a kitchen or bath for special needs?
items.a: A recent client hired HCS for a full kitchen and bathroom remodel built around his special needs and wrote that the team just helped him, without treating him any differently. Call and describe what you need in the room, and the team will talk through the options with you.

items.q: Where are you and when are you open?
items.a: HCS is at 7560 A E Beaty Dr, Memphis, TN 38133. The office is open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can also email shane@hcskitchenandbath.com at any time with photos and measurements of your room.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call (901) 384-8755 or email shane@hcskitchenandbath.com with your room size, a few photos and what you want to replace. HCS will work out cabinets, countertops and hardware with you and give you a price. Reviewers describe the prices as reasonable.

final_cta.h2: Ready for new cabinets or a full remodel?
final_cta.text: Call HCS or email Shane to talk through your kitchen or bath.
